title: FHIR Healthcare Service Instance Parameters
description: Parameters for provisioning a complete HL7 FHIR R5 healthcare service with HAPI FHIR server, PostgreSQL database, patient dashboard, and Keycloak authentication. Credentials must be pre-created in the instance namespace.

cluster_url.description: Target cluster server URL (optional, defaults to broker's cluster). Must be a registered ArgoCD cluster.

namespace.description: Target Kubernetes namespace for this FHIR service instance. Must be chosen by the operator before provisioning so secrets can be pre-created there.

fhir_secret_name.description: Name of the pre-existing Kubernetes Secret for FHIR database credentials. Must contain keys: postgres-db, postgres-user, postgres-password.

keycloak_secret_name.description: Name of the pre-existing Kubernetes Secret for Keycloak admin credentials. Must contain keys: admin-user, admin-password.

webmethods_secret_name.description: Name of the pre-existing Kubernetes Secret for webMethods integration credentials. Must contain keys: api-key, claim-endpoint, claimresponse-endpoint.

postgres_storage_size.description: Storage size for PostgreSQL persistent volume

fhir_replicas.description: Number of HAPI FHIR server replicas

enable_keycloak.description: Enable Keycloak authentication and SMART on FHIR

enable_webmethods.description: Enable webMethods EDI X12 integration for claims processing

fhir_memory_limit.description: Memory limit for HAPI FHIR server pods

fhir_cpu_limit.description: CPU limit for HAPI FHIR server pods

enable_narrative.description: Enable narrative generation for FHIR resources

ingress_host.description: Hostname for ingress (required if ingress_enabled is true)
